<!-- Generated by docs/scripts/generate.ts from the source code. Do not edit. -->

`x18n mcp` (stdio) and `x18n ui` (HTTP at `/__mcp`) serve these tools. [MCP](/agents/mcp) explains how to connect an agent.

Each tool takes one object. A `?` after a field name marks an optional field. The safety level tells the agent what a call does: `read` changes nothing, `action` writes files, `destructive` can remove data and asks for `confirm: true`.

## x18n_status

Safety: `read`

Overview of the i18n project: locales with translation coverage, counts of keys, resources and usages, diagnostics by check, and detected presets. Call it first to learn project names, the source locale and locale codes.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project`? | `string` | Project name from `x18n_status`. Required only in a monorepo with several projects. |

## x18n_keys

Safety: `read`

List message keys, paged. Filter by `missing` locale (keys to translate), `unused` (keys no code uses), `namespace` or a key `glob`. Pass `values: true` to get the value per locale. Continue with `cursor: nextCursor`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project`? | `string` | Project name from `x18n_status`. Required only in a monorepo with several projects. |
| `glob`? | `string` | Key glob: `*` inside a segment, `**` across segments. |
| `missing`? | `string` | Only keys missing or empty in this locale. |
| `unused`? | `boolean` | Only keys without usages in code. |
| `namespace`? | `string` |  |
| `values`? | `boolean` | Include the value per locale. |
| `limit`? | `number` | Page size. Default 100. |
| `cursor`? | `string` | `nextCursor` of the previous page. |

## x18n_get

Safety: `read`

One key: its value in every locale with file and line, locales where it is missing, usages in code with a few lines of context, and diagnostics. Check a key with it before creating or renaming one.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project`? | `string` | Project name from `x18n_status`. Required only in a monorepo with several projects. |
| `key` | `string` | Full key, for example `nav.home` or `common:save`. |

## x18n_search

Safety: `read`

Find keys by their value, best match first: the key behind a text seen in the app. Searches every locale, ignoring case, and matches fuzzily unless `exact`. Each match has the matched locale and value, and the usages in code with file, line and column.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project`? | `string` | Project name from `x18n_status`. Required only in a monorepo with several projects. |
| `query` | `string` | Text of the message, as seen in the app, in any locale. |
| `exact`? | `boolean` | Only values containing the query. By default a fuzzy match also counts. |
| `limit`? | `number` | Page size. Default 100. |
| `cursor`? | `string` | `nextCursor` of the previous page. |

## x18n_usages

Safety: `read`

Usages in code, paged: of one `key` (usages with a computed key under a prefix of it are marked `possible`), of one file (`path`), or all. Each usage has file, line, column and a code snippet.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project`? | `string` | Project name from `x18n_status`. Required only in a monorepo with several projects. |
| `key`? | `string` | Only usages of this key. |
| `path`? | `string` | Only usages in this file (path relative to the project root). |
| `limit`? | `number` | Page size. Default 100. |
| `cursor`? | `string` | `nextCursor` of the previous page. |

## x18n_check

Safety: `read`

Run the checks (missing translations, placeholder mismatches, invalid syntax, unused and undefined keys, ...) and return diagnostics, paged. After writing messages, call it with `only: ["placeholder-mismatch", "invalid-syntax"]` and fix what it reports.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project`? | `string` | Project name from `x18n_status`. Required only in a monorepo with several projects. |
| `only`? | `string[]` | Only these check ids, for example `placeholder-mismatch`, `invalid-syntax`, `missing-translation`. |
| `locale`? | `string[]` | Only diagnostics for these locales. |
| `limit`? | `number` | Page size. Default 100. |
| `cursor`? | `string` | `nextCursor` of the previous page. |

## x18n_translate_prompt

Safety: `read`

Instructions for translating missing messages into a locale: rules, glossary, style examples and the items with usage context, as markdown. Follow it, then write the results with x18n_set_messages. It says how many items remain and the cursor for the next batch.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project`? | `string` | Project name from `x18n_status`. Required only in a monorepo with several projects. |
| `locale` | `string` | Target locale code, as listed by `x18n_status`. |
| `keys`? | `string \| string[]` |  |
| `namespace`? | `string` |  |
| `limit`? | `number` | Messages per prompt. Default 50. |
| `cursor`? | `string` | `nextCursor` of the previous prompt. |
| `stale`? | `boolean` | Also translate stale translations: those older than their source message. |

## x18n_set_messages

Safety: `action`

Set many messages at once: `messages` is `{ "<locale>": { "<key>": "<value>" } }`, the same shape as `x18n apply`. Files keep their format, key style and order. When a value drops or adds placeholders compared to the source value, nothing is written and `problems` lists them (`applied: false`); fix the values, or pass `force: true`.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project`? | `string` | Project name from `x18n_status`. Required only in a monorepo with several projects. |
| `messages` | `object` | `{ "<locale>": { "<key>": "<value>" } }`, the same shape as `x18n apply`. |
| `force`? | `boolean` | Write values even when their placeholders differ from the source value. |

## x18n_rename_key

Safety: `destructive`

Rename a key (or every key under a parent) in all locales, and its usages in code unless `usages: false`. Without `confirm` it returns the plan (files to change, decisions, warnings); call again with `confirm: true` to apply it.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project`? | `string` | Project name from `x18n_status`. Required only in a monorepo with several projects. |
| `from` | `string` | Key (or parent of keys) to rename. |
| `to` | `string` | New key. |
| `usages`? | `boolean` | Also rewrite usages in code. Default true. |
| `confirm`? | `boolean` | Apply the plan. Without it, the tool only returns the plan. |
| `answers`? | `object` | Decision id to option id, for decisions in the plan. Default: each decision's `default`. |

## x18n_delete_key

Safety: `destructive`

Delete a key (or every key under a parent) in all locales, or only in `locales`. Code is not changed. Without `confirm` it returns the plan; call again with `confirm: true` to apply it.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project`? | `string` | Project name from `x18n_status`. Required only in a monorepo with several projects. |
| `key` | `string` | Key (or parent of keys) to delete. |
| `locales`? | `string[]` | Only in these locales. Default: all. |
| `confirm`? | `boolean` | Apply the plan. Without it, the tool only returns the plan. |
| `answers`? | `object` | Decision id to option id, for decisions in the plan. Default: each decision's `default`. |

## x18n_extract_plan

Safety: `read`

Find hard-coded strings in source files and propose a key, a message and a code replacement for each. Review the items (edit keys, drop items you do not want), then pass them to x18n_extract_apply.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project`? | `string` | Project name from `x18n_status`. Required only in a monorepo with several projects. |
| `files`? | `string[]` | Only these files (globs relative to the project root). Default: every scanned file. |

## x18n_extract_apply

Safety: `action`

Apply extraction items from x18n_extract_plan: adds the messages to the source locale and rewrites the code. Fails when a file changed since the plan was made; plan again then.

| Field | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `project`? | `string` | Project name from `x18n_status`. Required only in a monorepo with several projects. |
| `items` | `object[]` | Items from `x18n_extract_plan`, keys and replacements edited as needed; drop items to skip them. |
